# testing_x_match (Resource)

XMatch Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "testing_x_match" "my_xmatch" {
  object = {
    id = "...my_id..."
  }
  unmatched_string = "...my_unmatched_string..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `object` (Attributes) Object for verifying nested match configuration (e.g. object.id) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--object))
- `unmatched_string` (String) Non x-speakeasy-match string property

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--object"></a>
### Nested Schema for `object`

Optional:

- `id` (String) Nested id for verifying nested match configuration (e.g. object.id)

Read-Only:

- `unmatched_string` (String) Non x-speakeasy-match string property

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = testing_x_match.my_testing_x_match
  id = jsonencode({
    id        = "..."
    object_id = "..."
  })
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import testing_x_match.my_testing_x_match '{"id": "...", "object_id": "..."}'
```
